title: Kenworth T610 Series FUPS Compatible, Radar compatible High Tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #77
description: Kenworth T610 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar. 76mm diameter high tensile tube welded into drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds resulting in maximum protection. Heavy duty high tensile box uprights with internal welds for maximum strength and custom designed heavy duty extended fully reinforced main channel suitable for use with units fitted with Radar (Autonomous Emergency Braking). Flip over 5mm plate aluminium plate with Road Train signs. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements including custom centre light bar mount. Provision for lower front mudflaps. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
